scheme_name: Maternity Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: The worker must be employed in the organized sector in Gujarat.
The worker must have worked continuously with the same factory/company/organization for at least one year.
The worker’s Labour Welfare Fund must have been deposited with the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board.
The application must be submitted within one year from the date of delivery.
The benefit is available to either female workers or the wives of workers for only one delivery.
Assistance will not be provided if the pregnant woman's name on the birth certificate/document differs from the name on the bank passbook.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 is provided to female workers or the wives of workers for maternity expenses.
